tail: {"batch":"4","findings":[],"coverage_note":"Read all four assigned pages and all 91 assigned in-flight items in their current on-disk state, plus the dependency items named in §5 of research/phase-2-remaining-27-reader-4.md, and repaired 13 carriers: false step-level claims in lem-submultiplicative-root-limit (invalid t>=1 inequality), thm-spectral-radius-formula (difference quotient missing the factor a), thm-boundary-of-spectrum-lies-in-approximate-point-spectrum (wrong sign in the resolvent factorisation), ex-spectrum-of-the-unilateral-shift (claimed density on the whole closed disc, false for |lambda|<1) and lem-resolvent-identity (false claim that z1-a, z1-b and the two resolvents commute); a false remark in def-invertible-element-and-general-linear-group-of-a-banach-algebra (one-sided inverses do not suffice — the shift is a counterexample, now exhibited); one unjustified generalisation in ex-bounded-operators-form-a-noncommutative-banach-algebra, repaired by declaring the Axiom of Choice and importing the published bounded-projection result, with deps and facts [L4],[L5],[A1] added; and six citation/staleness/ill-formedness fixes (thm-maximal-ideals, lem-zero-set-ultrafilters, thm-every-commutative-c-star-algebra, ex-stone-duality-for-a-power-set-algebra, ex-gelfand-transform-of-ell-one-of-z, ex-c-zero-of-a-locally-compact-space). Reflow and precheck were rerun for every changed item (all PASS; batch precheck 66 checked, 0 failing) and the batch-4 proof contract validates at 0 errors / 91 items; no item carried a verification.judge record to remove, no item, page or claim was deleted, and no withdrawal is proposed. No uneditable defect remains, so findings is empty. Honest limitations: I did not read the full transitive dependency closure of all 91 items, so citations outside the list recorded in the report were checked through the citing item's own derivation and local consistency rather than by re-reading the cited item; the external PDFs behind the bibliographic locators were not fetched, so each claim was verified by direct derivation or against the cited library item, not against the external text; and I could not decide whether 'B(X) is noncommutative whenever dim X >= 2' has a choice-free proof, so the repair declares AC and the manifest clause for ex-bounded-operators-form-a-noncommutative-banach-algebra ('ZF ... no new choice principle is used') is stale for the 5b lead to reconcile (the manifest itself was left untouched)."}
